sql.processStepAction.getActionsForStep: select psa.*, psst.process_step_status_type, at.action_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(logic))) FROM ( SELECT psl.id, psl.archived, psl.process_step_requirement_id as "processStepRequirementId", psl.operation_type_id as "operationTypeId", ot.operation_type as "operationType", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psr.requirement_nbr as "requirementNbr" FROM flow.process_step_logic psl left join flow.operation_type ot on ot.id = psl.operation_type_id left join flow.process_step_requirement psr on psr.id = psl.process_step_requirement_id WHERE psl.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psl.archived is not true ORDER BY psl.sql_order ) logic), '[]') AS "processStepLogicList", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(children))) FROM ( SELECT psacp.id, psacp.archived, psacp.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psacp.process_step_id as "processStepId", psacp.trigger_automatically as "triggerAutomatically", psacp.display_order as "displayOrder", psacp.created_by_id as "createdById", psacp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById" FROM flow.process_step_action_child_process psacp WHERE psacp.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psacp.archived is not true order by psacp.display_order ) children), '[]') AS "processStepActionChildProcesses" from flow.process_step_action psa inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = psa.process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.action_type at on at.id = psa.action_type_id where case when :processStepId::integer is not null then psa.process_step_id = :processStepId else 1 = 1 end and case when :id::integer is not null then psa.id = :id else 1 = 1 end order by psa.action_name
sql.processStepAction.deleteAction: update flow.process_step_action set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :actionId
sql.processStepAction.deleteChildProcessFrom: update flow.process_step_action_child_process set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, archived = true, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.updateAction: update flow.process_step_action set action_name = :actionName, action_type_id = :actionTypeId, process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.insertAction: insert into flow.process_step_action(process_step_id, action_name, action_type_id, process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id, archived) values (:processStepId, :actionName, :actionTypeId, :processStepStatusTypeId, :createdById, false)
sql.processStepAction.insertLogic: insert into flow.process_step_logic (process_step_requirement_id, operation_type_id, sql_order, process_step_action_id, date_created, created_by_id) values (:processStepRequirementId, :operationTypeId, :sqlOrder, :id, now(), :createdById)
